faq_heading: Homes near Don Christian Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Don Christian Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Don Christian Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It matches the school’s name in the listing text. A home near Don Christian Elementary whose listing doesn’t mention it won’t appear.

faq.q: How much do homes near Don Christian Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 110 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,207,000, townhomes $720,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Don Christian Elementary?
faq.a: For the 110 homes that sold within 1 km of Don Christian Elementary, the median time on the market was 18 days and the median sale was 97.0% of list; 5% sold above list.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Don Christian Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Hillcrest Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Bibleway Christian Academy (0.7 km south-east) and Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.8 km south-east).

Don Christian Elementary is an elementary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 6256 184 St. It teaches grades K to 7.
Use the search below to see homes for sale that name Don Christian Elementary in the listing, then check the sold prices within 1 km of the school.
How the Don Christian Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Don Christian Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 1 km of Don Christian Elementary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 110 homes sold within 1 km of Don Christian Elementary: 83 houses and 23 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,207,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Don Christian Elementary

20 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Don Christian Elementary in a straight line (12 elementary, 5 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Hillcrest Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Langley Meadows Elementary, 3.0 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Bibleway Christian Academy (0.7 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Hillcrest Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.8 km south-east), Martha Currie Elementary (1.0 km south), Adams Road Elementary (1.1 km north), Latimer Road Elementary (1.7 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Hillcrest Elementary, 0.6 km north-east of Don Christian Elementary.
